content.myth: An expensive university means better teaching
content.detail: Look at course modules, faculty and location. Compare fees and courses side by side on Course Finder.

caption:
Myth: An expensive university means better teaching ❌

Fact: fit matters more than fees. Course Finder shows tuition fees side by side, so compare and then choose.
